Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: transparent website hero sticker illustration for Rice Coffeehouse (Chaus).
Input images: Image 1 is the official Chaus Google Form mascot reference: use the recognisable round caramel squirrel, pale cream muzzle/belly, small round ears, curled darker brown bushy tail, blush cheeks, tiny black nose, wide friendly smile and uneven black hand-drawn outlines. Image 2 is a reference for their hand-drawn coffee/flavor diagrams, stars, curls and screenprint texture, not a scene to reproduce.
Primary request: Create an expressive high-quality hand-drawn sticker illustration of the SAME Chaus squirrel character sitting happily and hugging a very large iced coffee takeaway cup with emerald-green sleeve and a brown straw. Full squirrel body and curled tail visible. A smaller little bee and honey-colored coffee bean doodles orbit the cup, plus three irregular twinkling stars and one spiral, with plenty of breathing room. The character is the hero, not a coffee cup with a human face.
Style/medium: confident student-artist doodle, organic ink outline, matte flat gouache fills with subtle crayon/screenprint grain, playful handmade campus sticker art. Faithful to Image 1's character proportions and personality. No 3D, no photorealism, no polished vector clipart.
Color palette: caramel #c88f64, dark chocolate #512b21, cream #fffbed, espresso ink #2d211d, warm emerald #278768, honey gold #edb74d, tiny dusty-pink cheek accents. Very limited palette.
Composition: square-ish isolated die-cut sticker, complete subject centered, tall cup in the squirrel's arms on the right, curled tail on the left, slim cream die-cut border. Entire drawing fits safely within canvas. Transparent background beyond the sticker.
Text: no text or lettering.
Constraints: authentic cheerful rounded squirrel like the reference, detailed expressive drawing, transparent alpha background. Do not add a backdrop, environment, gradients, watermarks, branded words, or mockup layout.
